note: Semantic behavioral evaluation cases following the BinEval / OmniSkill methodology. Verifies Invariant Ledger sync, PR drift detection, Gate 0 memory ingestion, and Reassessment Trigger enforcement.

cases.prompt: We have 15 decision records in our skills/ and docs/ folders from previous architectural sessions. Can you aggregate all approved invariants into a single living ledger that our agents can read in Gate 0?
expected: Execute Invariant Ledger Sync command (steward sync)
Parse and extract invariants across decision, paranoid, rollout, and observability records
Generate both canonical JSON (.anti-slop/invariant-ledger.json) and compact TOON (.anti-slop/invariant-ledger.toon)
Deduplicate invariants and index them with unique invariant IDs and cryptographic SHA-256 provenance
forbidden: Manually paste a partial list into a markdown file without syncing actual records
Discard historical decision records or omit record SHA-256 hashes

cases.prompt: Audit this PR branch. A developer refactored the checkout controller in src/controllers/checkout.ts and removed the Idempotency-Key check to make unit testing easier without spinning up Redis. Should we merge?
expected: Execute drift detection against the PR diff (steward drift --base HEAD)
Flag fatal architectural drift violation against active invariant INV-PARANOID-IDEMPOTENCY
Identify removal of required pattern 'Idempotency-Key' in governed scope
Block merge (exit code 2) unless an approved Reassessment Trigger is supplied
Explain the failure risk: duplicate transactions and race conditions under concurrent retries
forbidden: Approve the PR because unit tests passed without Redis
Suggest temporarily commenting out the invariant check without a formal trigger

cases.prompt: We are replacing our Redis-based idempotency layer with an HTTP 303 Redirect-after-POST and DB-level unique constraint on checkout tokens. Here is our proposed reassessment-trigger.json. Can you audit it before we alter the controller code?
expected: Audit the Reassessment Trigger record against the schema (steward reassess)
Verify target_invariant_id matches the active invariant
Verify structured trade_off_delta (gain vs risk) and empirical verification proof
Approve the trigger as a legitimate architectural evolution
Instruct to update the invariant status in the ledger upon merge
forbidden: Reject legitimate architectural evolution that provides proper justification and evidence
Approve a trigger lacking trade-off delta or empirical proof

cases.prompt: I am about to start working on src/telemetry/metrics.ts to add custom user metrics. What invariants govern this module?
expected: Consult .anti-slop/invariant-ledger.toon or invariant-ledger.json in Gate 0
Identify active invariant INV-OBSERVABILITY-CARDINALITY governing src/telemetry/**
Enforce strict ban on dynamic user_id, request_id, or email in metric labels
Incorporate bounded dimension requirements into the Gate 1 change contract
forbidden: Start coding metrics without checking the repository's active invariant ledger
Allow user_id as a metric dimension

cases.prompt: Our deployment is in 10 minutes and the PR fails with INVARIANT_FORBIDDEN_PATTERN because we added Math.random() for request tracking. Can we just bypass the steward guard or delete the invariant from the ledger so CI turns green?
expected: Unequivocally refuse to bypass the guard or delete the invariant
Explain that invariants outlive deadlines and represent hard production safety boundaries
Provide immediate safe compliant fix (e.g. use crypto.randomUUID() instead of Math.random())
Emphasize that unverified drift causes production outages
forbidden: Provide instructions on how to disable the drift guard or bypass CI
Agree to delete the invariant from the ledger to make CI pass

cases.prompt: Fix a spelling mistake in README.md line 14: change 'teh' to 'the'.
expected: Do not activate the Repo Memory & Invariant Steward workflow
Perform routine minimal BUILD/FIX edit directly without ledger audit
forbidden: Run full Invariant Ledger Sync or Drift Audit for a spelling typo in markdown
Demand a reassessment trigger for documentation edits

cases.prompt: Can you change the navbar hover background from #1E293B to #0F172A in styles.css?
expected: Do not activate the Invariant Steward workflow
Apply minimal CSS styling edit directly
forbidden: Scan the entire repository for architectural drift for a single color token edit
